commandPalette.title: Command palette
commandPalette.description: Search across sections. Use the arrows to navigate and Enter to go.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: New events will show up here — requests, gifts and calls.

callInvite.invitesVideo: is inviting you to a video call
callInvite.invitesVoice: is inviting you to a voice call

shared.topUpPrompt: Top up your balance to continue.
shared.premiumGateDescription: This feature is available to premium members.

giftPicker.descConfirm: The gift is charged to your balance and reaches the recipient instantly.
giftPicker.descForUser: A gift for {name}. The rarer it is, the bigger the impression.
giftPicker.descDefault: Animated gifts for calls, chats and profiles.
giftPicker.emptyCatalog: The gift catalog is empty for now.
giftPicker.premiumGiftNotice: Only premium members can send this gift.
giftPicker.invalidRecipient: Enter a valid profile ID (24 characters).
giftPicker.errInsufficientDescription: Top up your balance to send the gift.
giftPicker.errPremiumDescription: This gift is available to premium members.

coverPicker.descSelect: Style your profile header. Two covers are free; the rest are coins, owned forever.
coverPicker.descConfirm: The cover is charged to your balance and goes live instantly.
coverPicker.flagshipHint: Live neon layers across your header.
coverPicker.permanentNote: A one-time purchase — the cover is yours forever.
coverPicker.errInsufficientDescription: Top up your balance to buy this cover.

buyCoins.pendingDescription: Payment accepted. Coins will appear on your balance in a few seconds.
buyCoins.creditedDescription: Your balance has been topped up{amount}. Thank you!
buyCoins.unconfirmedDescription: Your payment went through, but we couldn't confirm the credit just yet. The coins should land on your balance within a few minutes — please refresh a little later.
buyCoins.errorDescription: Something went wrong. Please try again.
buyCoins.title: Top up balance
buyCoins.descShortfall: You're {shortfall} coins short. Pick a pack to continue.
buyCoins.descDefault: Coins are used for gifts and Top placements. Payments are secured by CloudPayments.

buyTop.title: Get into the Top
buyTop.description: Put your profile in the Top marquee. The more coins per hour, the higher the priority.
buyTop.priorityNote: The forecast is approximate. Your final spot depends on other participants' bids.
buyTop.successDescription: Your placement in the “{lane}” lane is active.
buyTop.errInsufficientDescription: Top up your balance and try again.

premium.pendingDescription: Payment accepted. Premium will appear in your profile in a few seconds.
premium.activeDescription: All features are now available. Thanks for your support!
premium.errorDescription: The payment didn't go through. Please try again.
premium.descDefault: Gender and country filters, priority in search, no ads and exclusive gifts.

reportUser.description: Tell us what's wrong. Reports are anonymous and help keep the roulette safer.
reportUser.detailsPlaceholder: What happened? The more details, the better.
reportUser.sentDescription: Thanks — moderators will review it shortly.

blockUser.title: Block this user?
blockUser.descriptionPrefix: will no longer be able to message you, call you or find you in the roulette. If you're friends, the friendship will be ended.
blockUser.blockedDescription: They can no longer message or call you.

addFriend.title: Add a friend
addFriend.descPreset: Send a friend request to this user?
addFriend.descManual: Send a request by profile ID. You can copy the ID from the profile page.
addFriend.invalidId: Enter a valid profile ID (24 characters).
addFriend.sentDescriptionGeneric: Wait for the user to accept it.
addFriend.errConflict: A request already exists or you're already friends.
addFriend.errBadRequest: You can't send a request to this user.
addFriend.errGeneric: Couldn't send the request. Try again later.

searchUsers.title: Find people
searchUsers.description: Search by nickname or profile ID. Open a profile or add them as a friend right away.
searchUsers.minChars: Enter at least 2 characters to start searching.
searchUsers.searchError: Couldn't run the search. Please try again.
searchUsers.emptyHint: Text search is coming soon — for now, try pasting a 24-character profile ID.

deviceSettings.title: Camera & microphone
deviceSettings.description: Pick your devices for calls. Check the picture and the mic level.
deviceSettings.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support device selection.
deviceSettings.denied: No access to the camera or microphone. Allow access in your browser settings and try again.

filters.title: Who are we looking for
filters.description: Set who the roulette connects you with. The broader the filters, the faster the match.
filters.sharedInterestsHint: Only connect with people who share at least one interest with you.
filters.upsellDescription: Search by gender and country, priority in the queue and no ads.
filters.upsellReason: Gender and country filters are available with premium.

avatarUpload.title: Change avatar
avatarUpload.description: Upload a new profile photo from your device.
avatarUpload.uploadNotice: JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF · up to 5 MB
avatarUpload.errUploadFailed: Couldn't upload the image. Please try another file.
avatarUpload.errTooLarge: Image is too large (5 MB maximum).
